Body.Content: End of Support for Microsoft Fabric Runtime 1.2 has been announced. Microsoft Fabric Runtime 1.2 will be deprecated and disabled March 31, 2026.   We strongly recommend upgrading your Fabric workspace and environments to use Runtime 1.3 (Apache Spark 3.5 and Delta Lake 3.2).
Body.Markdown:
End of

Support for Microsoft Fabric Runtime 1.2 has been announced. Microsoft

Fabric Runtime 1.2 will be deprecated and disabled March 31, 2026.

We strongly recommend upgrading

your Fabric workspace and environments to use Runtime

1.3 (Apache Spark 3.5 and Delta Lake 3.2) .
